title: PAN-OS User-ID Authentication Portal Root RCE
description: CVE-2026-0300 is a critical buffer overflow in the PAN-OS User-ID Authentication Portal (Captive Portal) that allowed an unauthenticated attacker to execute code with root privileges on affected PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls. Unit 42 reported exploitation by CL-STA-1132, followed by EarthWorm and ReverseSocks5 deployment, Active Directory enumeration, lateral movement and log cleanup. This package provides network and post-exploitation detection, hunting and response content.
threat_actor: CL-STA-1132 (Unit 42, assessed state-sponsored; named sponsor not established)
campaign_name: PAN-OS Captive Portal root RCE exploitation (2026)

simulation_steps.title: Send crafted traffic to exposed portal
simulation_steps.description: Attacker sends crafted requests to an internet-exposed User-ID Authentication Portal.

simulation_steps.title: Unauthenticated root RCE
simulation_steps.description: Buffer overflow (CVE-2026-0300) yields unauthenticated code execution as root on the firewall.

simulation_steps.title: Deploy EarthWorm and ReverseSocks5
simulation_steps.description: Attacker transfers and runs EarthWorm and ReverseSocks5 tunneling tools on the appliance.

simulation_steps.title: Active Directory enumeration
simulation_steps.description: From the firewall, the attacker enumerates Active Directory and internal systems.

simulation_steps.title: Lateral movement and log cleanup
simulation_steps.description: Attacker pivots to internal systems and removes logs to hinder investigation.

simulation_steps.title: Detect appliance-originated tunnels
simulation_steps.description: Blue team flags the firewall initiating sustained encrypted/SOCKS connections to previously unseen destinations.

simulation_steps.title: Isolate and remediate firewall
simulation_steps.description: SOC isolates the firewall, preserves evidence, removes tooling, upgrades PAN-OS and rotates exposed credentials.

family_metadata.advisory_title: Palo Alto Networks advisory and Unit 42 analysis for CVE-2026-0300
family_metadata.affected_products: PAN-OS PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls with an exposed User-ID Authentication Portal
family_metadata.exposed_surface: Internet-exposed PAN-OS User-ID / Captive Portal interfaces
family_metadata.exploitability: Confirmed exploitation by CL-STA-1132 (CVSS 9.3); KEV status not established in reviewed sources
